elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
HDI must, at the Company’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is required “for a period of up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data, and other Company data in HDI’s possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires a “standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required “within 30 days after expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete the returned Customer Data thereafter.
elements.evidence: HDI must “thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of the Customer Data thereafter.
elements.evidence: HDI must “certify such deletion to the Company in writing.”

elements.element: The fallback transition and data-export obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 is triggered upon expiration or termination for any reason.
HDI is expressly required to provide reasonable transition assistance at the Company’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Availability for up to six months encompasses the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor must provide Customer with an export of Customer Data.
elements.evidence: HDI must return the specified Company data to the Company in a standard machine-readable format, which constitutes a data export.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must be provided within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly sets a 30-day deadline after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The added Section 4.3 fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It adds only the requested exit mechanics, leaves the existing termination and payment terms intact, and introduces no contradiction. The Company-request condition appropriately places control of transition assistance with the Company rather than materially limiting the required availability.
